method: Actual recorded MCP tool calls using the original repository sample responses, with outbound networking disabled. No live travel requests were made.
display: Typeset recorded outcomes. Not original product UI, not a live lookup. Native radio controls select already recorded results.
private_evidence: Complete source snapshot, transport transcript, isolation evidence and 28 bounded checks retained in the private transit proof.
public_scope: Three original platform lookups and the original board. Constructed route fixtures are excluded from the main section.
mount: Existing Connected tools case, after case navigation and before starting-point prose. No new route or Lab.
limits: The original sample has no trip response, so plan_trip returns no connections. These cards do not prove route planning.
Original board rows have no journey reference. train_journey reports a board miss despite listing IC 123 among visible services. Full journey lookup is not demonstrated.
Sample notice fields do not match the current notice handler: default filtering finds none and all-mode results have unknown operator and validity window.

The sample ignores several request filters, returns fixed board order and uses an all-stations fallback for an unknown station query. It does not prove current upstream filtering, chronological ordering or station-search accuracy.
Separate deliberately constructed route responses were used privately to check the actual formatter. They are not original sample itineraries and are not shown in this section.
This recorded run does not establish live API availability, geographic correctness or current service conditions.
